thread:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: recurring regen latency is showing a pattern across 3 deploys. Error budget at 52% for the SLO window. We need concrete SLO updates + a tracking plan. Quick ideas?

jon: Can we add a p99 SLO focused on tail latency for the generate endpoint? p95 hides these backpressure spikes.

dina: I support a tail SLO. Proposal: keep current p95 at 350ms, add p99 target 850ms, and introduce a throughput SLO (requests/sec per node) to detect overload.

maria: The issue is spikes correlate with concurrent large-batch model rollouts. Also we lost visibility into per-deployment request rate. Need dashboard tags.

sam: Actionable plan: 1) add p99 SLO panel with deployment tag, 2) create a weekly recurring incident pattern report, 3) attach remediation owners and timelines to each postmortem action.

maria: Agree. Let's define the SLOs concretely: p95(gen_latency_end2end) <= 350ms, p99(gen_latency_end2end) <= 900ms, throughput SLO: 99th percentile requests_per_second_per_node >= X (we'll derive X from baseline). We should document method to compute X.

jon: I'll instrument the per-node request_rate metric and add labels for model_version and pool. Will add new panels to the SLO dashboard. Owner: jon, due: Tue COB.

dina: I'll compute baseline X from last 60 days and run a backtest to estimate how often adding the throughput SLO would have fired. Owner: dina, due: Wed EOD.

maria: For remediation tracking, propose a triage cadence: immediate (0-48h), short (3-14d), long (>14d). Each action needs owner, verification test, and rollback criterion. I'll add a remediation tracker doc. Owner: maria, due: Fri.

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-18: latency regression auto-summary posted. https://redwood/incident/2026-03-18

sam: Also propose an automation: if we see >2 p99 breaches in 7d, create a follow-up ticket and assign to the SLO lead. I'll draft the alert rule. Owner: sam, due: Mon.

jon: PromQL I'll use for p99 panel: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(gen_end2end_latency_seconds_bucket{path="/v1/generate"}[2m])) by (le, deployment)). Will tag by deployment and model_version.

dina: Backtest summary (prelim): p99 baseline ~1.1s over last 60d; with targeted batching improvements and kv-cache hit rate to 90% projected p99 -> ~820ms. Cost impact ~+6% on GPU time. Details in doc: https://redwood/notes/slo-backtest-1950012345

maria: Good. If backtest supports it, we can roll p99 SLO as a "soft" SLO for 30 days (no hard PD alerts) and collect burn metrics. If burn <40% after 30d we promote to hard SLO.

sam: For the remediation tracker template: fields = owner, due, priority (immediate/short/long), verification steps, rollback threshold, links. I'll add to the SRE board and wire a monthly reminder.

jon: Adding panels now. I'll create a secondary dashboard that only the SLO working group references for the 30d soft rollout.

dina: One more ask: include sequence-length buckets in the p99 panel so we can see if long-context requests are skewing the tail.

maria: Good catch. Tag queries by seq_len_bucket. Also make sure we exclude internal batch-replay tests from SLO metrics.

sam: Timeline recap: jon panel by Tue COB; dina backtest by Wed EOD; sam alert + tracker template by Mon; maria remediation doc by Fri. Weekly sync Friday 10am to review burn.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post the remediation doc and RFC draft for the p99 SLO later today. Please add comments in the doc. :white_check_mark:
